name: 33175 · Miami, FL
findings: ZIP 33175 (Miami) has 69 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33175 (Miami) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33175 (Miami) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).
